#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string str;
    std::getline(std::cin, str);
    int result = 0;
    for (size_t start = 0; start < str.length();) {
        size_t end = start + 1;
        while (end < str.length() && str[start] == str[end]) {
            end++;
        }
        result += ((end - start + 1) & 1);
        start = end;
    }
    std::cout << result << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
